metadata.name: Marine Sediment Geochemical Profile from Gulf of Mexico (GeoB16320-2)
metadata.description: Vertical sediment core profile dataset containing 34 depth-resolved samples of Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) concentrations from a single station in the Gulf of Mexico (Bay of Campeche). All samples were collected at a fixed location (23.84°N, 87.15°W) at a water depth of 626 m on March 24, 2012. The dataset covers sediment depths from 0.03 m to 4.18 m.
metadata.spatial: Point location (single station) with vertical resolution defined by sediment depth intervals (cm-scale)
